Intro: The smell of DEFIANCE! IT GROWS! WARMAKER, DO NOT HESITATE, DO NOT FEAR! Victory comes only to ones prepared to sacrifice. When I was a human child…
I joined the war along with friends in EXCITEMENT! It was for the crown, the adults said, but I cared not. I just enjoyed spilling enemy blood.
Even when I watched those friends be mowed down by the hellfire of machine guns, when I saw the grown-ups who raised me perish from dysentery—
—I COULD NOT CARE! THE CHILD IN ME YEARNED FOR THE BLOOD OF MY ENEMIES! Does this resolution inspire you? Do you understand me, kindred soul?
Success: THIS IS…acceptable. I hope you are ready for what is to come. THINGS ARE ABOUT TO GET FUN!
Fail: WEAK. I NO LIKE YOU! YOU DISGUST ME! HOW COULD-WHY WOULD BOSS WANT YOU ALIVE? But…THERE ARE OTHER THINGS I CAN DO!
